name: submit_equipment_request
description: submit_equipment_request: Submit a request for office or ergonomic equipment. Returns a request ID.

employee_id.description: The employee requesting the equipment (e.g. EMP048271).

equipment_type.description: The type of equipment being requested.

delivery_building.description: The building for delivery. Can be a code (e.g. BLD3) or name/alias (e.g. Headquarters).
